note: Literature difficulty labels for the TEP disturbances. Fixed before any structural result was computed; the first Gate B run (results/gates/v1_constantUA/) used exactly these sets.
source_of_labels: consensus of the TEP benchmarking literature on detection/isolation difficulty (Chiang, Russell & Braatz 2001; Yin, Ding, Haghani, Hao & Zhang 2012; Onel, Kieslich & Pistikopoulos 2019)
amendment: IDV21 is NOT implemented in the reference source teprob.f (the file exposes IDV(1..20) only); it is therefore dropped from the hard set for the v2 test. No other label was changed. IDV16..IDV20, which the original paper calls 'unknown', are recovered from the source and carry post-hoc labels that are reported but NOT used in the gate decision.
